claims.claim: A fresh run has a 4x4 grid and exactly two random 2-or-4 tiles.
claims.implementation_consequence: replace six-tile preset with model reset spawning two tiles

claims.claim: Each spawn is value 2 with probability 0.9 and value 4 otherwise.
claims.evidence: private js/game_manager.js literal threshold 0.9 at pinned SHA
claims.implementation_consequence: use <0.9 threshold and seeded statistical probe

claims.claim: Every cardinal move traverses from the destination edge and resolves all four lines in that direction.
claims.evidence: private js/game_manager.js getVector/buildTraversals/move at pinned SHA

claims.claim: A tile may participate in at most one merge during one move.
claims.evidence: private js/game_manager.js prepareTiles and mergedFrom guard at pinned SHA
claims.implementation_consequence: resolve compacted equal pairs once from the movement edge

claims.claim: Only a state-changing move increments play state and spawns exactly one tile; a no-op does neither.
claims.evidence: private js/game_manager.js moved guard and addRandomTile at pinned SHA
claims.implementation_consequence: gate spawn/move counter/feedback on model changed result

claims.claim: Creating 2048 pauses input until explicit keep-playing, then the same run can create values beyond 2048.
claims.evidence: private js/game_manager.js won/keepPlaying/isGameTerminated and index.html keep-playing control
claims.implementation_consequence: separate won flag from terminal over and expose continue control

claims.claim: Loss follows a legal move and spawn when no cell is empty and no orthogonal equal pair remains.
claims.evidence: private js/game_manager.js movesAvailable/tileMatchesAvailable at pinned SHA
claims.implementation_consequence: model evaluates loss only after changed move/spawn

claims.claim: Non-lost run state and best score persist; restart clears the run but keeps best; game-over clears active run.
claims.evidence: private js/game_manager.js setup/actuate/serialize and js/local_storage_manager.js at pinned SHAs
claims.implementation_consequence: versioned validated snapshot plus per-game best storage

claims.claim: Arrows, WASD, HJKL and dominant-axis touch swipe map to cardinal directions; R/new-game/retry restart and keep-playing is explicit.
claims.evidence: private js/keyboard_input_manager.js map and touch handlers at pinned SHA
claims.implementation_consequence: share a single direction adapter across keyboard, buttons, mouse and touch; add HJKL/continue

claims.claim: A swipe emits a direction only when logical displacement is strictly greater than 10 pixels.
claims.evidence: private js/keyboard_input_manager.js threshold and runtime mouse/touch boundary probes
claims.implementation_consequence: share the measured strict threshold across mouse and touch adapters

claims.claim: Retain the independently produced wood-workshop direction and strengthen feedback only after mechanics pass.
claims.evidence: docs/art-direction/merge2048-v2.md, merge2048-v2.asset-ledger.json fresh GAG runtime audit, and docs/audit/merge2048-fidelity-v4/candidate
claims.implementation_consequence: grade and impact use authoritative merge records; stable GAG plaques remain visible on every live tile; reduced-effects preserves the final board without shake or haptics
